therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PD-1 checkpoint inhibition combined with histone deacetylase inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation enhancement and epigenetic modulation to improve anti-tumor immunity
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with recurrent squamous cell head and neck cancer or salivary gland cancer that is metastatic and/or unresectable
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Incidence of toxicity graded according to NCI CTCAE v4.0

results.effect_size: ORR: 38% (8/21) in HNSCC, 17% (4/23) in salivary gland carcinoma
subgroup_findings: Higher response rate in HNSCC (38%) compared to salivary gland carcinoma (17%)
Stable disease achieved in 38% HNSCC and 57% salivary gland carcinoma patients
results.dose_information: Pembrolizumab given IV, Vorinostat given PO or via PEG

context.duration: Up to 2 years treatment, up to 7.5 years follow-up
